en: Color postcard showing a warm orange sunset over a calm lake with reeds and a tree silhouette in the foreground. The back has Romanian printed captions and address template, a blue "POSTA ROMANA" stamp (Arta Populara, 2L), Bucharest postmarks dated 1982, and a handwritten Romanian message and address. The printed caption identifies the view as Eforie Sud, sunset on the lake.
